item.title: Stuff in the works!
item.description: hello all! you might have observed by my talks of Game Boy Advance hardware on fedi but I have a very big post with a deluge of information and documentation of legacy cartridges in the works! it probably will not be finished in a very long while as there is much to cover, photograph, record, and (currently) acquire, but I hope to make it on the level of, i dunno, a Cathode Ray Dude video. i really hope it proves to be a worthy primary source of information on these devices. that's all, stay tuned.

item.title: Various Security and Counter Changes
item.description: heya! so i just updated my site with a few changes. at first it was over the counter being ticked up several thousand times over the course of a single night, which i discovered to be the work of many crawlers and scraping bots, to which I added a measure in the counter's php code that prevents a "fuzzy" list of bots from incrementing it. but then i noticed that zuck's AI scraper was hitting my site, so I went completely nuclear and added a regex measure in my Caddy config that terminates connections from those scrapers. if there's anything that personally impacts you that i screw up please get in touch!
